memoryBuilder.verseText: Abram believed God. So God said Abram was right with Him.

sequence.prompt: What happened on the night of the stars? Put it in order.

items.label: Abram waited years with no children
Abram told God how he felt
God took him outside to see the stars

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: How big Abram's family would be
It made him right with God

application.question: Abram had nothing in his hands but a promise. What are you still waiting for?
application.followUp: You can tell God honestly, just like Abram did. He does not scold — sometimes He takes us outside and shows us the stars.
